newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Empire surges 16.22 pct in midtrade.
newsitem.headline: Empire surges 16.22 pct in midtrade.

text.p: Empire East Land Holdings Inc jumped 60 centavos, or 16.22 percent, to 4.30 pesos by midtrade on Monday as investors resorted to bargain-hunting, brokers said.
"People are looking at bargains already and one of those issues being looked at is Empire East," said Jonathan Ravelas, head of sales at Asian Capital Equities Inc.
One trader said a new brokerage firm was the biggest buyer of Empire shares. "Fundamentally, there's no reason for the buying. There's nothing new with the firm," said the trader.
Empire and its parent firm, Megaworld Properties & Holdings Inc had suffered the brunt of rumours circulating since last April that the property sector was headed for a crash.
Megaworld gained 15 centavos, or 5.08 percent, at 3.10 pesos in midtrade.
Empire was the second most actively traded issue in midsession with 117.9 million pesos worth of shares changing hands.
